## Where

specs/001-docs-site/, docs/adr/, CLAUDE.md, docs/roadmap.md

## Goal

Resolve plan Q-1 to Q-7 with the recommended options (play checklist now; onboarding item; privacy page published early; WCAG AA before the user book publishes; NNN-fNN-slug spec folders; advisory docs check then required with always-run; user guide publishes at M7 with a test banner), give each accepted con a named guard owned by a ledger item, and make merging an ADR count as accepting it

## Done when

Plan decision ledger and spec updated; CLAUDE.md and ADR-0000 state the merge rule; merged ADRs read accepted; owner merges
seen.title: Record the owner's answers to spec 001 Q-1 to Q-7 and the merged-means-accepted ADR rule
